decisions.raw: 전투 당 1회 처음 파쇄가 3까지 쌓인 적을 향한 공격은 중복으로 무효처리 되지 않음.

confirmedRule.effect: Prevent collision-based invalidation of the attack against the enemy identified by the first Shatter 3 threshold occurrence.

decisions.interpretationBoundary: The user confirmed the effect identity, threshold and combat scope. Selection among simultaneous allied attacks and reservation ordering must be specified in the subsequent complete contract; this decision record does not silently choose them.
